scope: Every module and listed current version in the captured official index, including yanked entries; not all historical versions. No code executed.

limits.large_text: streamed without per-text truncation; oversized single lines use rolling overlap

limitations: Keyword inventory requires semantic review; common abstractions and absolute absence of all similarity cannot be proved by keyword scan. Limited/unavailable/error entries are explicitly not covered.

limitations.reason: text contains UTF decoding replacement; inspect original encoding before claiming complete textual coverage
